hypothesis: RNA-conditioned continuous token prompts change the pathology concept semantics before encoding by frozen TITAN text transformer.

controls.S0: Static TITAN concept cosine scores with a class-balanced linear head
controls.S1: Static learnable token prompt, shared across patients
controls.S2: RNA-conditioned token prompt: RNA Top512 -> 16D -> softmax pool over four Lx768 prompt bases
controls.S3: Static TITAN concepts concatenated with a 16D RNA adapter
controls.S4: S2 model evaluated with a cyclic wrong-patient RNA context on outer-test

prompt_injection.location: after original BOS token and before the original concept token sequence
prompt_injection.templates: the locked Phase6A two-template CRC morphology ensemble
prompt_injection.text_transformer: TITAN frozen; gradients flow only to prompt pool, RNA adapter/gate and classifier head

evaluation.schedule: fixed three-epoch outer-train fit; no label-driven epoch selection

storage.titan_weights: retain verified 635 MB snapshot on GPU server for repeated token-level runs
storage.publish: scripts, fixed configuration and aggregate reports only; no weights, raw RNA, embeddings, clinical rows or patient OOF
